computed_scope: exact low-degree complex scalar S3=SU(2) Clebsch--Gordan product coefficients plus full/product-projected associativity bookkeeping only

declared_conventions.basis: Q^(n)_(mL,mR)=sqrt((n+1)/(2*pi^2)) D^(n/2)_(mL,mR), with n nonnegative integer and doubled labels 2*mL,2*mR in {-n,-n+2,...,n}
declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3 identified with SU(2), Haar volume Vol(S3)=2*pi^2
declared_conventions.phase: SymPy Condon--Shortley Clebsch--Gordan convention; outputs are convention-specific complex-basis golden data and must be translated before comparison with a real basis
declared_conventions.product: Q_a Q_b=sum_c sqrt((n_a+1)(n_b+1)/(2*pi^2*(n_c+1))) CG(j_a,mLa;j_b,mLb|j_c,mLc) CG(j_a,mRa;j_b,mRb|j_c,mRc) Q_c
declared_conventions.projection: P_L retains scalar degrees n<=L after the full product. (1-P_L) is reported as a finite algebraic projection remainder only.

exact_checks.statement: Every nonzero output has an allowed scalar degree and doubled left/right magnetic labels.
The declared low-mode Wigner-D product equals the preregistered exact complex-basis coefficient table.
Every nonzero output has an allowed scalar degree and doubled left/right magnetic labels.
The nonzero output degrees match the preregistered SU(2) triangle/parity selection rule.
The unprojected selected scalar product is associative in the declared Wigner-D realization.
The selected repeated hard projection has the preregistered nonzero finite associator.
Every left-parenthesization discarded intermediate component lies outside P_L.
Every right-parenthesization discarded intermediate component lies outside P_L.
For the left parenthesization, P_L of the full product is reconstructed from the repeated-projection result plus the explicitly discarded intermediate contribution.

primary_sources.not_used_for: the Wigner-D phase convention, full Gaunt coefficients, ADM constraints, HDA or BFV
primary_sources.source: L. Lindblom, N. W. Taylor and F. Zhang, Scalar, Vector and Tensor Harmonics on the Three-Sphere, Gen. Rel. Grav. 49 (2017) 139, arXiv:1709.08020
primary_sources.used_for: unit-S3 scalar spectral convention lambda_n=n(n+2) and degeneracy (n+1)^2

primary_sources.not_used_for: the repository's normalization, projected-remainder classification, or any constraint-algebra conclusion
primary_sources.source: A. P. Stone, Some properties of Wigner coefficients and hyperspherical harmonics, Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 52 (1956) 424--430
primary_sources.used_for: the SU(2)/hyperspherical-harmonic representation-theory route underlying a Wigner-D Clebsch--Gordan product realization

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: This pins a complex scalar basis only. It neither supplies a real-basis translation nor vector/TT modes, derivative Gaunt data, ADM constraints, or an HDA theorem.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: The unit round S3 is identified with SU(2), Haar volume is 2*pi^2, and the complex Wigner-D basis has the declared Condon--Shortley phase convention.
theorem_guards.theorem: Scalar harmonics on S3 identified with SU(2) matrix elements

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The exact arithmetic evaluates only selected low-degree product coefficients. It is not a complete scalar Gaunt table and does not construct a cubic gravitational vertex.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: The two left/right magnetic labels use the same SU(2) Clebsch--Gordan convention and the displayed volume normalization.

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: A projected associator is a finite projection remainder. It is neither a DD/DH/HH residual nor a classical or quantum anomaly.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: P_L is applied after each selected product exactly as declared; the full product is evaluated before its discarded components are classified.
theorem_guards.theorem: Hard spectral projection does not preserve a product algebra in general
